checked.claim: A curtain the 4 s / 9 s watchdog mounts before document.fonts.ready never gets observe(): no MutationObserver, ResizeObservers or watchTrayFold.
checked.why: observe() has one caller, go() inside refreshGlass, and go() mounts and observes only when no curtain stands. The watchdog calls mount() alone; mount() pushes the curtain and starts the loop and rebuild() but connects nothing. Once a curtain stands, refreshGlass takes the rebuild() branch and never reaches go() again, so the observers come only after an unmount and a fresh mount (a theme switch, the screen leaving glassRoom). registerGlass's own resize listener, visibilitychange, canvasReady, AV lift and drpgLayoutHeight still schedule recuts, as the reader says. Whether fonts.ready can take over 4 s at a real table is not measured, which the reader already says; nit fits.

R3985 (tests-tier1.mjs 46986) reads that clip to the moving panes' shared part, so such a swap would be caught by the suite rather than ship. The hygiene observation stands; the scenario is overstated. Nit stays.
